parameters.name: NetworkId
parameters.description: The ID of the network resource.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the general quota.

parameters.name: SortBy
parameters.description:
The list of sort fields. Fields such as scheduled time and start time are supported. The format is "sort field + sort order (Desc/Asc)" (Asc is the default if omitted). Valid values:

- Id (Desc/Asc): route ID
- DestinationCidr (Desc/Asc): destination CIDR
- CreateTime (Desc/Asc): creation time

Default value: CreateTime Asc.
